steps.title: Getting started
tips: Pick up Mining and Blacksmithing right away and craft armor from the ore you mine.
Cast Battle Shout before each pull and keep it up the whole fight.
Go easy on Heroic Strike: it costs rage and the swing it replaces generates none, so rage runs dry fast at low levels.
From level 4, open with Charge and apply Rend. Rend now hits harder and can critically strike, making it a core Arms ability.

steps.title: Two-hander and Thunder Clap
tips: All your damage comes from your weapon. Craft Copper Claymore at 6 to switch to a two-hander, and keep upgrading so it never falls behind.
Thunder Clap, learned at 6, slows attack speed by 20%. Keep it on every pull to take much less damage.
Open every pull with Charge → Rend → Thunder Clap.

steps.title: First talents
tips: Put your level 10–12 points into Improved Rend to raise the bleed damage of Rend by 35%. The bleed you put on every mob gets stronger, so each kill goes faster.
Once you have Sunder Armor, apply it a few times after Thunder Clap until the mob dies.
Swap to Heavy Copper Maul at 11.
Overpower at 12 is your most rage-efficient attack; don't miss its procs.

steps.title: Collect dungeon quests
tips: Dungeon mobs give little XP; the XP is in the dungeon quests. Grab every quest before you go in and share them with the group. It also makes it easier to get invited.
Pick up the two-hander Axe of Orgrimmar from the Ragefire Chasm quests. Dungeon quest rewards have been upgraded a lot; Axe of Orgrimmar is now a blue item.
Pick up the two-hander Ironforge Greathammer from the The Hall of Thanes quests. Dungeon quest rewards have been upgraded a lot.

Put your level 13–14 points into Deflection for 2% more parry chance, then two points into Improved Overpower at 15–16 to raise the crit chance of Overpower by 50%. You take less damage while soloing, and Overpower crits so often that mobs die faster.
Keep Thunder Clap up in dungeons too; its large attack speed slow greatly cuts the damage your tank takes.

steps.title: Deep Wounds and dungeon gear
tips: Put your level 17–18 points into Improved Charge for 6 more Rage from Charge, so you have the Rage for Rend and Thunder Clap the moment you reach the mob. Take the first point of Improved Tactical Mastery at 19, and start Deep Wounds at 20 so every crit adds a bleed.
Farm Wailing Caverns, The Deadmines and Ruins of Lordaeron for Strength mail and two-handers. Dungeon loot is stronger now, so a run can be worth it for one item even without quests.
Victory Rush heals 10% of your max health and is a game-changer for questing. Use it whenever it is available.
You also learn Slam and Cleave now. Only use Slam right after an auto-attack swing.
For your final two-hander, get Forsaken Greataxe from a Ruins of Lordaeron quest or Hammerbone from a Wailing Caverns quest.

steps.title: Execute and Tactical Mastery
tips: Finish Deep Wounds at 21–22: every crit then adds a bleed for 60% of your weapon's average damage over 12 sec. At 23–24, put two more points into Improved Tactical Mastery so you keep up to 9 Rage when you switch stances.
Critical strikes with basic attacks now generate 75% more Rage, so crit from talents and gear also feeds your Rage.
Execute at 24 works only on enemies at 20% health or less and turns all your extra Rage into damage. Dump your Rage into it to finish mobs.
Intimidating Shout at 22 sends nearby enemies fleeing in fear. Use it to get out when too many mobs are on you.
In crowded areas, open with Rend or Sunder Armor. Either one tags the mob to you instantly.
In Blackfathom Deeps and The Stockade, go for Strength gear like Bands of Serra'kis, and craft Shining Silver Breastplate with Blacksmithing.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus XP as before, so run dungeons for gear more than for experience.

steps.title: Gnomeregan and a weapon upgrade
tips: Take Spearing Strike, an attack for 40% weapon damage, at 25, then max Improved Tactical Mastery at 26–27 so you keep up to 15 Rage when you switch stances. Anger Management at 28 generates 1 Rage every 3 sec in combat so you run dry less often, and at 29 put a point into Two-Handed Weapon Specialization.
Manual Crowd Pummeler from Gnomeregan is the two-hander to aim for before 30. Pick up Pugilist Bracers and Wolfclaw Gloves in Razorfen Kraul.
Craft Veteran's Chain Helm, Veteran's Silvered Chain Leggings and Barbaric Iron Shoulders with Blacksmithing.
Finish the class chest quest while you run Razorfen Kraul.

steps.title: Level 30: Sweeping Strikes and Berserker Stance
tips: Your level 30 talent is Sweeping Strikes. Your next 5 melee attacks hit one more nearby enemy, so when two mobs are on you, you wear both down in the time it takes to kill one.

Berserker Stance raises your crit chance by 3% but also increases damage taken by 10%. Thanks to Improved Tactical Mastery you keep Rage when you switch, so move between it and Battle Stance as the fight calls for.
Go for Morbid Dawn, Ebon Vise and Ironspine's Eye in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, and craft Barbaric Iron Helm and Officer's Belt with Blacksmithing.

steps.title: Thunder Clap and gear
tips: Thunder Clap, learned at 6, slows attack speed by 20%. Keep it on every pull to take much less damage.
Protection also scales strongly with gear, especially weapons, so keep your weapon and armor current.

steps.title: Defensive Stance and Shield Specialization
tips: Put every point from 10 to 14 into Shield Specialization: more blocks, and blocks generate rage, which fixes much of your rage shortage.
At 10 you learn Defensive Stance, Taunt and Bloodrage. Thunder Clap works in Defensive Stance, which makes tanking dungeons far easier.
Sunder Armor generates very little threat, so tabbing it across a pack won't hold aggro; outside of bosses, prioritize your other abilities.

steps.title: Revenge and Shield Block
tips: Revenge at 14 and Shield Block at 16 are your core. With Shield Specialization, Shield Block is rage-neutral when both charges are used, it's your most reliable Revenge proc, and it cuts incoming damage a lot, so use it freely.
Put your level 15–17 points into Improved Thunder Clap to lower the rage cost of Thunder Clap.
Demoralizing Shout at 14 generates no extra threat, so only use it to apply the debuff.
Dungeon mobs give little XP; the XP is in the dungeon quests. Grab every quest before you go in and share them with the group. It also makes it easier to get invited.

steps.title: Improved Bloodrage and Master of Defense
tips: Put your level 18–19 points into Improved Bloodrage for more rage from Bloodrage. Use Bloodrage right after Charge when you open a fight.
Charge doesn't work in Defensive Stance, so set up a macro that swaps to Battle Stance to charge.
From 20, take Master of Defense. Dodging or parrying with a shield equipped generates Rage, so your Rage keeps flowing even while soloing.
Don't forget Retaliation: it hits very hard when several enemies surround you, and swapping to a two-hander for its duration makes it much stronger. Use Victory Rush whenever it is up, too.
Protection warriors bring no thorns-style damage, so a druid or paladin in the group makes dungeons much easier.

steps.title: Improved Revenge and Vanguard
tips: Max Master of Defense at 21 to gain 5 Rage on every dodge or parry, then take Improved Revenge at 22–24. Revenge is your strongest single-target attack, so +20% damage per point is a big gain.
Critical strikes with basic attacks now generate 75% more Rage, so crit from talents and gear also feeds your Rage.
In crowded areas, open with Rend or Sunder Armor. Either one tags the mob to you instantly.
Tank Blackfathom Deeps and The Stockade for Jimmied Handcuffs, and craft Guard's Silvered Chain Shirt with Blacksmithing.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus XP as before, so run dungeons for gear more than for experience.

steps.title: Challenging Shout and Shield Wall
tips: Take Vanguard at 25: Charge becomes usable in Defensive Stance, so you can charge every mob without switching stances. Take Improved Sunder Armor at 26–28 to make Sunder Armor cheaper, then Last Stand at 29 for a temporary 30% of your maximum health in emergencies.
Challenging Shout at 26 forces all nearby enemies onto you for 6 sec; use it when mobs rush your healer. Shield Wall at 28 cuts damage taken by 60% for 12 sec; save it for heavy boss hits.
Pick up Seal of Sylvanas from a Shadowfang Keep quest and Arctic Buckler from a Blackfathom Deeps quest, and craft Protector's Chain Helm and Guard's Silvered Chain Leggings with Blacksmithing.
Tank Razorfen Kraul for Plains Ring, and finish the class chest quest while you're there.

steps.title: Level 30: Concussion Blow and Scarlet Monastery
tips: Your level 30 talent is Concussion Blow. It stuns the target for 5 sec, stopping a dangerous cast or holding one enemy for a moment.
Tank Scarlet Monastery Graveyard for Ghostshard Talisman, Ironspine's Ribcage, Ebon Vise and Scarlet Boots.
Also pick up Shoni's Disarming Tool from a Gnomeregan quest and craft Sentinel's Belt with Blacksmithing.
Razorfen Downs (entry 25) and Uldaman (entry 30) are open, but their recommended level is above 30. Go with a geared group.
If you're entering The Forever Open, the level 30 duel tournament, set up your talents, gear and consumables with the Warrior edition of the duel tournament guide.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Auto-attacks and Judgement
tips: Keep Devotion Aura on and Seal of Righteousness up, and fight with auto-attacks. With Seal of Righteousness active your auto-attacks deal Holy damage.
At 4 you learn Judgement and Blessing of Might. Judgement no longer removes your Seal, so use it on cooldown and only reapply the Seal when it expires. Keep the blessing on yourself.
Holy Light is your only heal, and it is expensive and slow. Drink between pulls and don't pull several enemies at once.
Pick up Mining and Blacksmithing right away and wear the copper mail you make.

steps.title: Holy Strike and a two-hander
tips: Holy Strike, learned at 6, is an instant Holy attack that ignores armor. Use it with Judgement right as the fight starts, then press it on cooldown.
Against enemies that will live a while, use Seal of the Crusader for your first Judgement to raise the Holy damage they take, then switch back to Seal of Righteousness.
Hammer of Justice at 8 is your only crowd control. Save it for dangerous enemies.
Out in the world a two-handed weapon beats a one-hander and shield. Make Copper Claymore or Copper Battle Axe.

steps.title: First talents and healing gear
tips: Put your level 10–11 points into Divine Strength for 4% more Strength. Solo questing is auto-attacks and Holy Strike, so mobs die faster. From 12, take Divine Intellect. Intellect raises your maximum mana and spell crit chance rather than spell power, giving you more mana for Holy Light.
For healing gear, look for items that explicitly add healing, not just Intellect. Make Glowing Copper Boots at 10 and Acolyte's Chain Belt at 12.
Keep questing with a two-hander; Heavy Copper Maul is available at 11.
At 12 the class quest that teaches Redemption opens up.

steps.title: Divine Intellect and first dungeons
tips: Fill Divine Intellect to five points by 16 for 10% more Intellect. You fight longer between rests, so you spend less time drinking.
In dungeons before 20 you can't keep casting Holy Light for long. Save your mana for healing and drink back up between pulls.
At 15, make Acolyte's Gloves and Acolyte's Chain Shirt.
Always keep an aura on; from 16 you can use Retribution Aura instead of Devotion Aura.

steps.title: Improved Seals, then Flash of Light
tips: Put your level 17–19 points into Improved Seals for 15% more damage from your Seals and Judgement. It speeds up solo questing.
At 17, make Acolyte's Boots.
Don't use high spell power weapons before 20. They carry a melee damage penalty of about 25%, so a normal melee weapon hits harder.
You have no interrupt in dungeons, so save Hammer of Justice for the most dangerous enemy of each pull and make full use of utility like Blessing of Freedom and Blessing of Protection.
Once you learn Flash of Light, make it most of your healing. Holy Light costs too much mana and takes too long to cast.
One point in Reverence lets part of your mana regeneration continue while casting.
Craft Acolyte's Silvered Chain Helm and Acolyte's Chain Leggings, and switch to a spell power weapon such as Scepter of the Abandoned or Pathfinder's Clearway.
When questing alone, drop Consecration when you have several enemies on you.

steps.title: Reverence and Healing Light
tips: Fill Reverence to three points by 22 so 30% of your mana regeneration continues while casting. Healing yourself through fights drains less mana, so you rest less.
Put your level 23–24 points into Healing Light to raise the healing of Holy Light and Flash of Light by 8%. You get more healing out of the same mana.
Use Purify to remove poisons and diseases from your party. Aku'mai in Blackfathom Deeps spreads poison clouds.
Pick up Prelacy Cape and Nimbus Boots from Blackfathom Deeps quests, and make Acolyte's Silvered Chain Shirt at 22.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Illumination and Razorfen Kraul
tips: Take Divine Favor at 25: your next heal is a guaranteed critical, a big burst of healing when things go wrong. Put four points into Illumination at 26–29. A critical heal then has an 80% chance to refund 50% of the spell's base mana cost, which pairs well with the spell crit from Divine Intellect.
Death Speaker Jargba in Razorfen Kraul drops Death Speaker Robes (level 26) and Death Speaker Scepter (level 28), a chest piece and weapon with lots of bonus healing.
Some enemies in Razorfen Kraul heal themselves. Paladins have no interrupt, so stop the heal with Hammer of Justice.
Gnomeregan drops Thermaplugg Medal of Honor and Electrocutioner Lagnut. At 25, make Acolyte's Silvered Chain Leggings.

steps.title: Level 30: Holy Shock
tips: Your last point goes into Holy Shock: Holy damage on an enemy, an instant heal on an ally. Use it for urgent heals on the move, or as your opener while questing.
If the Fallen Champion rare spawns in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, look for Embalmed Shroud. At 30, make Prefect's Belt.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Benediction and Seal of Fury
tips: From 10, Benediction cuts the mana cost of your instant spells and abilities, so Holy Strike and Judgement last longer, and it lays the groundwork for keeping Consecration up after 20.
Cast Seal of Fury (level 10) before engaging and keep it up. Using Judgement with it also taunts the target to attack you for a short time.
At 12, make and wear Crusader's Chain Belt. Heavy Copper Maul at 11 is a good two-hander for the world.
At 12 the class quest that teaches Redemption opens up.

steps.title: Righteous Fury: tanking begins
tips: From 15, Holy Conduit reduces the mana cost of Consecration and Exorcism; it pays off as soon as you learn them at 20.
You can only hold threat reliably once you learn Righteous Fury at 16, so don't force the tank role in dungeons before then.
Retribution Aura, learned at 16, only picks up new spell power gear when you turn it on again, so re-cast it after every upgrade.
At 15, make Crusader's Gloves and Crusader's Chain Shirt.

steps.title: Tanking Deadmines, then Consecration
tips: From 17, Improved Judgement shortens the cooldown of Judgement, and Deflection at 19 adds Parry chance.
Use a shield in dungeons. Good picks are Seedcloud Buckler and Sporid Cape from Wailing Caverns and Bandsaw Wristbands from The Deadmines.
Make Crusader's Boots at 17 and Crusader's Silvered Chain Helm at 20.
Don't use high spell power weapons before 20. They carry a melee damage penalty of about 25%, so a normal melee weapon hits harder.
Consecration makes holding several enemies much easier, and now is the time to switch to a spell power weapon such as Scepter of the Abandoned or Pathfinder's Clearway.
One point in Pursuit of Justice increases your movement speed, which is a big help at these levels.
Where there are lots of casters, such as Wailing Caverns, break line of sight to pull them into your Consecration.
You can't pull from range without special items or Engineering bombs. You also have no interrupt, so save Hammer of Justice for the most dangerous enemy.

steps.title: Redoubt: tanking with a shield
tips: From 21, put five points into Redoubt in the Protection tree. Melee hits against you have a chance to sharply raise your block chance, so it only helps while you have a shield equipped.
Seal of Fury also needs a shield to give you an absorb shield on each melee hit. In dungeons, always use it with a shield.
With Seal of Justice (level 22) active, Judgement stops the target from fleeing for 10 sec. Use it on enemies that run away at low health.
In The Stockade the prisoners stand in groups in each cell. Pull them out to the corridor and hold them in your Consecration.
Crested Scepter, dropped by trash in Blackfathom Deeps, is a one-handed mace with spell power that boosts Consecration. At 22, make Guard's Silvered Chain Shirt.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Precision and Blessing of Salvation
tips: Finish Redoubt at 25, then put three points into Precision at 26–28 for 3% more hit chance. Fewer misses mean faster kills while soloing. Start Anticipation at 29.
Put Blessing of Salvation (level 26) on your damage dealers and healer. It lowers the threat they generate, so enemies stay on you.
At 25, make Protector's Chain Helm and Guard's Silvered Chain Leggings. Both come with defense skill.
Technician's Bracers, a Gnomeregan quest reward, is a bracer with Strength and Stamina.
You can enter Razorfen Downs from 25, but its recommended level is 34. From 26 you can also run Excavation Site: Wetlands.
Some enemies in Razorfen Kraul heal themselves. Paladins have no interrupt, so stop the heal with Hammer of Justice.

steps.title: Level 30: tanking Scarlet Monastery
tips: Put the second point into Anticipation at 30 for 8 more Defense Skill. Mobs land fewer hits, so you take less damage.
Undead roam Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. Use Exorcism on cooldown and hold packs with Consecration.
In Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, look for Watchman Pauldrons and Scarlet Boots, and Ebon Vise if the Fallen Champion rare spawns. At 30, make Sentinel's Belt.
Divine Intervention at 30 sacrifices you to pull one party member out of the fight. When a wipe is certain, use it on your healer so they can resurrect the group afterwards.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Benediction and mana
tips: From 10, Benediction cuts the mana cost of instant abilities like Judgement and Holy Strike.
Until Benediction is maxed at 14, mana is tight. Don't chain-pull, drink between fights, and watch how many enemies you pull since you may need to heal yourself.
Switch to Heavy Copper Maul at 11, and make Crusader's Chain Belt at 12.
At 12 the class quest that teaches Redemption opens up.

steps.title: Conviction and first dungeons
tips: Put your level 15–19 points into Conviction for 5% more melee crit chance. Auto-attacks and Holy Strike crit more often, so mobs die faster.
In The Hall of Thanes, collect the quest rewards Cryptwalker Bracers and Deepgrave Trousers.
Ruins of Lordaeron drops Atrophic Girdle and Abomination Bones (level 15) and Bonerust Leggings and Corpse Chopper (level 16). Also make Crusader's Gloves at 15.
Retribution Aura, learned at 16, only picks up new spell power gear when you turn it on again, so re-cast it after every upgrade.

steps.title: Conviction, Deadmines and Consecration
tips: Max Conviction by 19, then start Pursuit of Justice at 20. One point already gives 8% more movement speed, cutting the time you spend running between quests.
In The Deadmines, aim for Smite's Mighty Hammer and First Mate Band. If you're doing the Verigan's Fist quest, start it before your first The Deadmines run to save an extra trip.
At 17, make Crusader's Boots and pick up Grip of Fear from Ruins of Lordaeron.
You have no interrupt in dungeons, so save Hammer of Justice for the most dangerous enemy of each pull and make full use of utility like Blessing of Freedom and Blessing of Protection.
Only drop Consecration against several enemies; against one it usually isn't worth the mana. Use Exorcism on cooldown against Undead and Demons.
Collect Rift Bracers and Duskbringer from Shadowfang Keep and the The Deadmines quest reward Chausses of Westfall, and craft Crusader's Silvered Chain Helm.
Your class quest rewards Verigan's Fist, a strong two-hander.
Forsaken paladins earn Wolfsbane, a strong two-hander, from a class quest.

steps.title: Seal of Command
tips: Finish Pursuit of Justice at 21 for 15% more movement speed, mounted or not.

Seal of Command, taken at 22, is a Seal that gives your melee attacks a chance to add Holy damage equal to 70% of weapon damage. The bonus follows your weapon damage, so it gets stronger with a better two-hander.
Put your level 23–24 points into Sanctified Judgement. Each Judgement refunds part of the Seal's mana, so judging on cooldown drains less mana and you rest less.
With Seal of Justice (level 22) active, Judgement stops the target from fleeing for 10 sec. Use it on enemies that run away at low health.
Pick up Band of the Fist from a Blackfathom Deeps quest. At 24, make Shining Silver Breastplate.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Sacred Arbiter and Gnomeregan
tips: Sacred Arbiter at 25 raises Holy Strike damage by 20% and refreshes every Judgement effect on the target each time it hits. Use Holy Strike on cooldown and even a Seal of the Crusader Judgement never falls off.

Take Vindication at 26–27 and 29. Your melee attacks can lower the target's attack power by 200 and raise yours, so you take less damage and deal more while soloing. At 28, put the last point into Sanctified Judgement to get back 60% of the judged Seal's mana.
Manual Crowd Pummeler, dropped by Crowd Pummeler 9-60 in Gnomeregan, is a level-29 two-handed mace and your level-30 target weapon.
In Razorfen Kraul, look for Pugilist Bracers and Wolfclaw Gloves from trash. Some enemies there heal themselves. Paladins have no interrupt, so stop the heal with Hammer of Justice.
Make Veteran's Chain Helm and Veteran's Silvered Chain Leggings at 25, and Barbaric Iron Shoulders at 27.
If you keep pulling threat in a group, put Blessing of Salvation (level 26) on yourself instead of Blessing of Might. It lowers the threat you generate.

steps.title: Level 30: Vengeance
tips: Your last point goes into Vengeance. Landing a crit raises your Physical and Holy damage for 30 sec, stacking up to 3 times, which pairs well with the crit from Conviction.
Seal of Light at 30 gives your melee attacks a chance to heal you. Try it while questing solo to cut down on downtime.
Look for Ironspine's Eye and Morbid Dawn from the rare spawns in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. Use Exorcism on cooldown against the undead there.
At 30, make Officer's Belt.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Kite without a pet
tips: Auto Shot has no cast time, so you can shoot on the move. Until you have a pet, back away and keep shooting before mobs reach you.
Restock arrows or bullets every time you pass an outpost, village or city. Without ammo you can barely do anything.
Learn Skinning as early as possible and skin everything you kill. The leather goes into Leatherworking gear.
From level 4, apply Serpent Sting in every fight.

steps.title: Hunter's Mark and your first shots
tips: You learn Hunter's Mark and Arcane Shot at 6. Open with Hunter's Mark → Serpent Sting → Arcane Shot.
At 8, use Concussive Shot to slow mobs closing in and keep your distance.
Keep skinning and raising Leatherworking. From 15 you wear gear you made yourself.

steps.title: Tame your pet
tips: At 10, get the class quest from your hunter trainer. Finishing it lets you use Tame Beast and train pets.
Shoot from behind while your pet holds the mob. Even if you pull aggro, Auto Shot works on the move, so it is easy to lead the mob back to your pet.
Visit the pet trainer for pet abilities and teach them to your pet. Get Claw by taming a Clattering Crawler, Shore Crawler, Black Bear Patriarch or Den Mother.
Keep your pet fed with Feed Pet, and from 12 top it up with Mend Pet.
Deadly Aspects, your talent from 10 to 14, gives Auto Shot a chance to raise your ranged attack speed while Aspect of the Hawk is active. Keep Aspect of the Hawk on while questing.

steps.title: First leather gear
tips: When you head into Wailing Caverns, look for Gloves of the Fang, wearable from 14.
At 15, craft and wear Trapper's Leather Armor. The "Trapper's" leather pieces are all strong except the headpiece.
At 15 and 16, take Focused Fire. It raises both your and your pet's damage while the pet is out, so always keep it summoned.

steps.title: Fang set and Aimed Shot
tips: In Wailing Caverns, aim for Leggings of the Fang and Footpads of the Fang at 17, and Venomstrike at 19.
At 18, craft and wear Deviate Scale Belt.
Multi-Shot at 18 is for fighting several mobs at once.

At 17 and 18, take Pathfinding to add 6% to the speed of Aspect of the Cheetah, cutting the time you spend running between quests. At 19, put a point into Endurance Training for 3% more pet Health and Armor, and from 20 Unleashed Fury raises the damage of your pet and hawks.
You learn Aimed Shot at 20. Use Aimed Shot on a single target and Multi-Shot on several. The two share a cooldown.
At 20, craft Brawler's Leather Hood, Trapper's Leather Pants and Fletcher's Gloves. For the head, the Brawler's hood beats the Trapper's one.
Use Aspect of the Cheetah from 20 to travel faster. Taking damage dazes you, so switch back to Aspect of the Hawk near mobs.
If Legacy gives you extra talent points, put them into Beast Mastery to reach Summon Hawk early. It needs 15 points in the tree.

steps.title: A stronger pet and Blackfathom Deeps
tips: From 21 to 24, max out Unleashed Fury to raise the damage of your pet and hawks by up to 15%. The faster your pet kills, the less you stop between pulls.
Scorpid Sting at 22 lowers the target's chance to hit. Only one of your Stings fits on a target, so use Serpent Sting normally and Scorpid Sting on hard-hitting elites and bosses.
In Blackfathom Deeps, go for Fallenroot Longbow (wearable from 23) and pick up the quest rewards Staghide Armguards and Band of the Fist.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience, so run dungeons for gear rather than experience.
Your pet's Aggressive mode is back in the pet tab of your spellbook. Leave it off in dungeons so your pet doesn't pull extra packs.
At 22, craft and wear Trapper's Leather Tunic.

steps.title: Rapid Fire and Frost Trap
tips: Rapid Fire at 26 raises your attack speed by 40% for 15 seconds. It has a 5-minute cooldown, so save it for dangerous fights and bosses.
Frost Trap at 28 slows nearby enemies by 60%. When several mobs are on you, drag them over it and open up some distance.
At 28 you get new ranks of Aspect of the Hawk, Arcane Shot, Aimed Shot and Mend Pet all at once, so don't skip the trainer.

From 25 to 28, Ferocity raises the critical strike chance of your pet and hawks by up to 8%, and at 29 take Summon Hawk. The hawk dive-bombs your target and keeps attacking for 18 sec, speeding up your kills a lot.

Pick up Petrolspill Leggings and the quest reward Fire-welded Bracers in Gnomeregan, and Mantle of Thieves and the quest reward Lancer Boots in Razorfen Kraul. For your ranged weapon, Concealed Hand Crossbow from The Stockade is a great pick from 26.
The new Excavation Site: Wetlands dungeon opens at 26.
At 25, craft and wear Brawler's Leather Helm.

steps.title: Finishing your level-30 gear
tips: Your level 30 talent is Bestial Discipline. It raises your pet's Focus regeneration by 10% and lets 25% of your Mana regeneration continue while casting, so you rest less.
You learn Feign Death at 30. Use it to shed aggro or to get out of a wipe.
At 30, all four Scarlet Monastery wings and Uldaman are open. Look for Ebon Vise in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard.
Finish your level-30 gear with Dusky Leather Armor and Stalker's Leather Belt from Leatherworking.

tips: At 21 and 22, bring Efficiency to three points for 9% lower mana costs, then take Rapid Killing at 23 and 24. It cuts the cooldown of Rapid Fire by 2 min, and each kill makes your next Shot within 20 sec deal 20% more damage, so the next mob goes down fast too.

steps.title: Finishing your level-30 gear
tips: Your level 30 talent is Trueshot Aura, which raises the Ranged Attack Power of party members within 45 yds by 30.

steps.title: Basics and professions
tips: Build combo points with Sinister Strike and finish with Eviscerate. Early on, auto attacks do a big share of your damage.
Once you learn Backstab at level 4, put a dagger in your main hand and use it from behind the target. It is this spec's main builder.
Pick up Skinning and Leatherworking right away. Turn the leather you skin into early armor for empty slots.
Level First Aid too. Bandages and healing potions cut downtime between pulls and give an instant heal in a pinch.

steps.title: Keep your main-hand dagger fresh
tips: Your main-hand dagger decides how fast you kill. Upgrade it whenever you can from quest rewards or dungeon drops.
As your Leatherworking skill rises, swap into the next tier of leather armor.
Move up to the next bandage as well.

steps.title: First talents
tips: From 10, put your talent points into Malice to raise the crit chance of all your attacks and poisons. The faster mobs die, the less damage you take and the less you rest.
From level 10, keeping Slice and Dice up is your top priority. Refresh it just before it falls off.
Get the Leatherworking pattern and craft Brawler's Leather Belt for your belt slot.

steps.title: First dungeons
tips: Finish Malice at 14 for 5% more crit, then take Remorseless Attacks at 15 and 16. After a kill, your next Backstab or Sinister Strike within 20 sec gets 40% more crit chance, so the next pull starts fast.
Ragefire Chasm and The Hall of Thanes (level 13), Ruins of Lordaeron (15) and The Deadmines (16) open up.
In dungeons, much of your value comes from preventing damage to your group. Sap no longer breaks Stealth, which makes it reliable crowd control.
Alternate Kick and Gouge to stop casts. If the group is mostly physical, Expose Armor raises everyone's damage.
Pick Lock opens certain locked doors in dungeons, such as the one before the last area of The Deadmines.
The Ruins of Lordaeron quest reward Edward's Knife is a solid main-hand dagger.
At 15, craft chest and hand armor with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Dungeon gear and poisons
tips: From 17 to 19, take Ruthlessness. Your finishers have a 60% chance to give you a combo point right away, so the next finisher comes sooner.
At 20, take Relentless Strikes. Your finishers have a 20% chance to restore 25 Energy per combo point spent, so you run out of Energy less often.
Wailing Caverns (level 17) drops the most rogue leather gear. Aim for legs, feet, hands, cloak and shoulders.
For weapons, aim for the dagger Assassin's Blade from Shadowfang Keep (level 18) in your main hand and Thief's Blade from The Deadmines in your off hand.
At 17, craft your boots with Leatherworking.
Craft the head and legs with Leatherworking to complete all six crafted pieces.
Pick up Pyrewood Signet Ring from the class quest, and go for Erudite's Amulet and Field Researcher's Loop, rewards for collecting library books.
From 20 you can make poisons and apply them to your weapons. Keep Instant Poison on both weapons.

steps.title: Lethality and Vanish
tips: From 21 to 24, take Lethality to raise the critical strike bonus damage of Backstab and Sinister Strike. Paired with the crit chance from Malice, mobs go down fast.
Vanish at 22 drops you back into stealth mid-fight. Use it to escape when too many enemies are on you or you're about to die.
Mind-numbing Poison at 24 slows enemy casting. In dungeons with lots of casters, put it on your off-hand.
Fenrus' Hide, dropped by Fenrus the Devourer in Shadowfang Keep, is an Agility cloak you can wear from 22.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Vile Poisons and Cheap Shot
tips: Finish Lethality at 25 for 20% more critical strike bonus damage, then take Vile Poisons from 26 to 29 to raise your poison damage by up to 16%.
Cheap Shot at 26 is a stun used from stealth that awards 2 combo points. Open on dangerous enemies with it and unload while they're stunned.
Look for the dagger Vendetta (level 26) and Mantle of Thieves (level 25) from trash in Razorfen Kraul, and Petrolspill Leggings (level 25) from trash in Gnomeregan.
Some enemies in Razorfen Kraul heal themselves. Interrupt the heals with Kick.
Make Brawler's Leather Helm at 25 and Barbaric Bracers at 27 with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Level 30: Mutilate, Kidney Shot and Deadly Poison
tips: Your level 30 talent is Mutilate. It strikes with both weapons at once for 2 combo points and deals 20% more damage to poisoned targets. Keep poisons on your weapons and use it to build combo points.
Kidney Shot at 30 is a finisher that stuns longer the more combo points you spend. Use it to stop a cast or hold a dangerous enemy for a moment.
Deadly Poison at 30 is a damage-over-time poison that stacks up to five times on a target, good for long fights.
The dagger Torturing Poker, dropped by Interrogator Vishas in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, is your level-30 main-hand target.
In wings packed with Scarlet soldiers, such as Scarlet Monastery Library, Sap one enemy in each pack before the pull.
At 30, make Dusky Leather Armor and Skulker's Leather Belt with Leatherworking.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Basics and professions
tips: Build combo points with Sinister Strike and finish with Eviscerate. Combat relies heavily on auto attack damage.
Get a slow axe, mace, sword or fist weapon as soon as you can, and spend your silver on that weapon skill.
Pick up Skinning and Leatherworking right away. Turn the leather you skin into early armor for empty slots.
Level First Aid too. Bandages and healing potions cut downtime between pulls and give an instant heal in a pinch.

tips: Your main-hand weapon decides how fast you kill. Upgrade it whenever you can from quest rewards or dungeon drops.
As your Leatherworking skill rises, swap into the next tier of leather armor.
Move up to the next bandage as well.

Get the Leatherworking pattern and craft Brawler's Leather Belt for your belt slot.

tips: Finish Setup at 21 and every dodge against your target adds a combo point. Raising your dodge chance with Ghostly Strike makes it happen more often.

steps.title: Level 30: Hemorrhage

steps.title: Get a wand early
tips: Kill one enemy at a time with Smite and use Lesser Heal between fights if needed. Keep Power Word: Fortitude up at all times.
Learn Shadow Word: Pain at level 4 and open every fight with it. It does much more damage than Smite.
Equip a wand as soon as you can: Novice's Practice Wand at level 1, then Lesser Magic Wand at level 5, both made with Enchanting. Wands cost no mana, so you rest far less.
New spells and ranks become available every two levels starting at 2. Visit a priest trainer whenever you pass through a town.

steps.title: Shield before you pull
tips: Cast Power Word: Shield, learned at level 6, before every pull. It absorbs damage and stops hits from pushing back your casts. It lasts up to 30 seconds, so you can cast it out of combat.

Mana only regenerates after 5 seconds without casting. If you run dry against several enemies, stick to your wand and stop casting long enough to afford a Power Word: Shield or a heal. Spirit increases this regeneration.
Keep Renew, learned at level 8, on yourself when your health is a worry.
Loot every enemy for cloth and save it for Tailoring.

steps.title: Wand Specialization and Spirit Tap
tips: Your first two points go into Wand Specialization. It adds 25% wand damage, and your wand does most of the work while leveling.

At 12, put your first point into Spirit Tap. Killing an enemy that gives experience has a 20% chance to raise your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec, so your mana refills faster between pulls and you rest less.
Mind Blast arrives at level 10. From level 12 keep Inner Fire up alongside Power Word: Fortitude; both are big survivability gains.
At level 10 a class quest opens that grants a race-specific spell.
Look for spell power, Intellect and Spirit on gear. Early drops are mostly plain armor-only items, so fill your waist, chest and hands with Tailoring.

steps.title: Better wand, first dungeon heals
tips: Switch to Greater Magic Wand at level 13. You make it yourself with Enchanting.
Ragefire Chasm, The Hall of Thanes and The Deadmines open up. Dungeon quests give more experience than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.
You will usually heal in dungeons. Keep Renew on the tank, use Heal (level 16) as your efficient main heal, and Power Word: Shield when a big hit is coming or someone suddenly drops low.

From 13 to 16, max out Spirit Tap. With all five points, every kill that gives experience raises your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec, and during that time 50% of your mana regeneration continues while casting. You can chain pulls and stop to drink far less often.
If the group already has a healer, you can deal damage instead; your talents up to 16 are the same as a Shadow priest's.
If you pull aggro, use Fade. It only lasts 10 seconds, so the tank has to take the enemy back in that window.
Bring plenty of water into dungeons. You will need to drink every few pulls, and almost every innkeeper sells it.
If you are not an enchanter, the Deepblaze wand from The Hall of Thanes is especially valuable.

steps.title: Twin Disciplines and Flash Heal
tips: From 17 to 19, put three points into Twin Disciplines: instant spells like Power Word: Shield, Renew and Shadow Word: Pain deal and heal 3% more. At 20, put your first point into Improved Power Word: Shield so your shield absorbs 7% more.
Use Dispel Magic, learned at level 18, to remove Magic debuffs from allies. In early dungeons, people die if nobody dispels.
In dungeons, it is fine to wand enemies when everyone is healthy.
Make Double-Stitched Woolen Shoulders with Tailoring for your shoulders.
Level 20 brings Holy Fire, Flash Heal and Fear Ward. Open fights with Holy Fire, and in dungeons use Flash Heal when someone is in imminent danger.
Do the level 20 class quest for your race's second spell.
Not an enchanter? Get your wand from dungeons: Deepblaze from a The Hall of Thanes quest, Sable Wand from a The Deadmines quest, or Sizzle Stick and Firebelcher in Wailing Caverns.
Carry your Tailoring cloth set up to Spidersilk Boots, then fill the remaining slots with the dungeon drops and dungeon quest rewards listed below.

steps.title: Improved Shield and Twin Disciplines
tips: At 21–22, finish Improved Power Word: Shield so your shield absorbs 20% more, then max Twin Disciplines at 23–24 for 5% more damage and healing on instant spells. A stronger shield makes it much easier to survive when several mobs are on you.
Mana Burn at 24 burns an enemy's mana and damages it. Use it on enemy healers and casters that rely on mana.
Dextren Ward in The Stockade fears the party. Put Fear Ward on your tank before the fight.
At 22, make Pristine Gown with Tailoring. Prelacy Cape and Nimbus Boots, rewards from Blackfathom Deeps quests, also come with bonus healing.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Meditation and Mental Agility
tips: At 25–27, put three points into Meditation: 50% of your mana regeneration continues while casting, so your mana keeps coming back mid-fight. At 28–29, put two points into Mental Agility to cut the mana cost of Smite, Holy Fire and your instant spells by 7%.
Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul casts Renew on herself. Remove it with Dispel Magic.
At 25, make the off-hand Orb of Souls with Enchanting. From 26 you can switch your wand to Lesser Mystic Wand.

Death Speaker Scepter and Wind Spirit Staff from Razorfen Kraul, and Thermaplugg Medal of Honor and Electrocutioner Lagnut from Gnomeregan, are good healing gear. At 25, make Pristine Leggings with Tailoring.

steps.title: Level 30: Soul Warding and Prayer of Healing
tips: Your last point goes into Soul Warding. It cuts the cooldown of Power Word: Shield by 4 sec and its mana cost by 15%, so it's easier to shield up before every pull.
Prayer of Healing at 30 heals the whole party at once. It costs a lot of mana, so save it for when several people have taken heavy damage.
Buff your party's Spirit with Divine Spirit at 30, and keep it up alongside Power Word: Fortitude.
Scarlet Monastery Graveyard is full of undead. Lock down a dangerous one with Shackle Undead while you fight the rest.

Look for Embalmed Shroud and Necrotic Wand from the rare spawns in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. At 30, make Gilded Slippers, and upgrade your wand to the Greater Mystic Wand you can craft or the Necrotic Wand from the Graveyard.

tips: From level 17 put two points into Improved Shadow Word: Pain. Shadow Word: Pain lasts 6 seconds longer, so each cast does more damage both solo and in groups.
From 19, take Shadow Focus to raise the hit chance of your Shadow spells.
Against several enemies, put Shadow Word: Pain on the extras when mana allows, then return to your main target.
Use Dispel Magic, learned at level 18, to remove Magic debuffs from allies. In early dungeons, people die if nobody dispels.
Level 20 brings Holy Fire, Flash Heal and Fear Ward. You can open fights with Holy Fire if you like.
Do the level 20 class quest for your race's second spell.
Not an enchanter? Get your wand from dungeons: Deepblaze from a The Hall of Thanes quest, Sable Wand from a The Deadmines quest, or Sizzle Stick and Firebelcher in Wailing Caverns.
Carry your Tailoring cloth set up to Spidersilk Boots, then fill the remaining slots with the dungeon drops and dungeon quest rewards listed below.

steps.title: Mind Flay
tips: Finish three points of Shadow Focus at 21 and take Mind Flay at 22. It channels damage over 3 sec and slows the target by 50%. Follow up Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Pain with it.
From 23, put four points into Improved Mind Blast so you can cast Mind Blast more often.
Dextren Ward in The Stockade fears the party. Put Fear Ward on your tank before the fight.
At 22, make Shadow Gown with Tailoring.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience as before, but they still give more than regular quests, so pick them up before you go in.

steps.title: Vampiric Embrace and Shadow Weaving
tips: Cast Vampiric Embrace (level 27) on an enemy and your whole party is healed for part of the Shadow damage you deal. Enemies that die with it on can also trigger Spirit Tap even if someone else lands the killing blow, which makes mana easier in dungeons.
From 28, put three points into Shadow Weaving. Each Shadow spell that hits raises your Shadow damage by 2%, stacking up to five times.
Devouring Plague is a damage-over-time spell on a 1-minute cooldown that heals you for the damage it deals. Put it on enemies that will live a while.
At 25, make the off-hand Orb of Mystic Insight with Enchanting and Shadow Leggings with Tailoring. From 26 you can switch your wand to Lesser Mystic Wand.
In Gnomeregan, pick up Spidertank Oilrag and the quest reward Shilly Mitts.
In Razorfen Kraul, look for Staff of the Shade, a staff with Shadow damage dropped by trash.

steps.title: Level 30: Scarlet Monastery
tips: Look for Bloodmage Mantle, Blighted Leggings and Embalmed Shroud in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard. At 30, make Black Slippers and upgrade your wand to Greater Mystic Wand.
Scarlet Monastery Graveyard is full of undead. Lock down a dangerous one with Shackle Undead while you fight the rest.
Buff your party's Spirit with Divine Spirit at 30, and keep it up alongside Power Word: Fortitude.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Melee basics
tips: Put Rockbiter Weapon on your weapon and fight with auto attacks.
Pull from range with Lightning Bolt or Earth Shock, then melee.
When a fight goes badly, turn leftover mana into health with Healing Wave.
At level 4, do the class quest for Earth Totem.
Learn Skinning and Leatherworking and level them together.

steps.title: Upgrade weapons, save mana
tips: Swap to a better weapon as soon as you see one. Your damage comes from your weapon.
From level 8, keep Lightning Shield up between pulls.
After the pull, hold your spells and save mana.
Keep your pulls in check.

steps.title: Fire totem, pick a weapon imbue
tips: Use Rockbiter Weapon on slow two-handers and Flametongue Weapon on fast one-handers.
Do the level 10 class quest for Fire Totem to use Searing Totem. From 12, use Fire Nova on groups.
From 10 to 14, take Thundering Strikes. The extra crit chance boosts your auto attacks right away.
Craft Murloc Scale Shoes and Brawler's Leather Belt with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Chest piece, first dungeon
tips: Craft Murloc Scale Breastplate with Leatherworking.
At 15 and 16, take Improved Ghost Wolf. Once you learn Ghost Wolf at 20, it is instant and works indoors.
From 16, run The Deadmines. In dungeons, drop Searing Totem and use Fire Nova as much as you can, stopping when you risk pulling threat or run out of mana.
Help your healer with your healing spells when things get dicey.

steps.title: Mental Dexterity and Ghost Wolf
tips: From 17 to 19, take Mental Dexterity. It adds attack power based on your Intellect.
Your level 20 talent is Shamanistic Focus, which lowers the mana cost of your shocks and Lightning Shield.
Train Ghost Wolf first, then start the Water Totem class quest.
Go for Tail Spike in Wailing Caverns and Smite's Mighty Hammer in The Deadmines.
Pick up a slow two-hander such as Hammerbone from a Wailing Caverns quest or Forsaken Greataxe from a Ruins of Lordaeron quest.

steps.title: Elemental Weapons and totems
tips: Take Elemental Weapons at 21–23. It raises the attack power bonus of Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, Flametongue Weapon damage by 15%, and the Windfury Weapon effect you learn at 30 by 40%. Take Ancestral Knowledge at 24.
Drop your chosen totems at once with Call of the Elements, and pick them up with Totemic Recall after the fight to get back 25% of their mana cost.
Totemic Projection at 22 moves your active totems to a spot you choose, so you don't have to recast them when the fight shifts.
Craft Brawler's Leather Tunic and Fletcher's Gloves with Leatherworking.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus XP as before, so run dungeons for gear more than for experience.

steps.title: Stormstrike and Flurry
tips: Take Stormstrike at 25. It strikes instantly with your weapon and boosts your next Lightning Bolt or Earth Shock within 12 sec by 20%. Follow Stormstrike with Earth Shock.
Take Flurry at 26–30. A melee crit speeds up your next three swings by 25%, which pairs well with the crit from Thundering Strikes.
Magma Totem at 26 deals Fire damage to nearby enemies every 2 seconds. Pair it with Fire Nova against groups.
Go for a slow two-hander like Corpsemaker in Razorfen Kraul, and craft Defender's Leather Helm, Brawler's Leather Legguards and Barbaric Bracers with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Level 30: Windfury Weapon
tips: Once you learn Windfury Weapon at 30, put it on your main hand. Each hit has a 20% chance to grant two extra attacks, which works best with a slow, hard-hitting two-hander.
Call of the Ancestors at 30 can drop a different totem set than Call of the Elements. Keep one set for solo play and one for groups.
Reincarnation at 30 lets you rise again on the spot with 20% health and mana after dying.
Go for Spirewind Fetter in Uldaman and Ironspine's Eye in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, and craft Prowler's Leather Belt and Barbaric Shoulders with Leatherworking.
Razorfen Downs (entry 25) and Uldaman (entry 30) are open, but their recommended level is above 30. Go with a geared group.
If you're entering The Forever Open, the level 30 duel tournament, set up your talents, gear and consumables with the Shaman edition of the duel tournament guide.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Fight with your weapon
tips: Spell base damage is low, so your weapon beats your spells for now. Put Rockbiter Weapon on your weapon and fight with auto attacks.
Pull with Lightning Bolt or Earth Shock, then melee and let mana refill with the five-second rule.
When a fight goes badly, turn leftover mana into health with Healing Wave.
At level 4, do the class quest for Earth Totem.
Learn Skinning and Leatherworking and level them together.

steps.title: Upgrade weapons, save mana
tips: Swap to a better melee weapon as soon as you see one.
From level 8, keep Lightning Shield up between pulls.
Pool mana at the end of kills and between enemies.

steps.title: Fire totem and Convection
tips: Use Rockbiter Weapon on slow two-handers and Flametongue Weapon on fast one-handers.
Do the level 10 class quest for Fire Totem. Dropping a Fire totem and, from 12, using Fire Nova on cooldown is your main damage from here.
Your talents go into Elemental from 10. Put five points into Convection from 10 to 14. It cuts the mana cost of your shocks and Lightning Bolt by up to 10%, so you stop to rest for mana less often.
Craft Moonglow Boots with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Start collecting spell power
tips: When rank 3 Lightning Bolt arrives at 14, keep casting rank 2. Rank 3 actually does less damage.
At 15–16, start putting points into Concussion. It raises the damage of Lightning Bolt and Earth Shock, so you kill faster.
Fang of Magmatus from The Hall of Thanes and Buzzer Blade from The Deadmines (from level 16) are daggers with spell power.
In groups, help your healer with your healing spells when things get dicey.

steps.title: Concussion and Elemental Focus
tips: Max out Concussion at 17–19 to raise Lightning Bolt and Earth Shock damage by 5%.

Your level 20 talent is Elemental Focus. After you cast an offensive spell, you have a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state that reduces the mana cost of your next offensive spell by 100%. Those free casts save mana, so you rest less.
Against groups, drop Searing Totem and use Fire Nova on cooldown until you run low on mana.
Train Ghost Wolf, then start the Water Totem class quest.
Get Staff of Westfall or Dreamer's Leggings from The Deadmines quests.

steps.title: Elemental Alacrity and Call of Flame
tips: At 21–23, put three points into Elemental Alacrity. Lightning Bolt casts 0.50 sec faster, so pulling and killing take less time. At 24, put your first point into Call of Flame for 5% more damage from Flame Shock, Fire Nova and your Fire totems.
Drop your chosen totems at once with Call of the Elements, and pick them up with Totemic Recall after the fight to get back 25% of their mana cost.
Go for Rod of the Sleepwalker in Blackfathom Deeps, and craft Stormrider's Leather Tunic with Leatherworking.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus XP as before, so run dungeons for gear more than for experience.

steps.title: Eye of the Storm and Magma Totem
tips: At 25, take Call of Thunder for 3% more crit chance on Lightning Bolt, then put three points into Eye of the Storm at 26–28. Pushback on Lightning Bolt drops by 70% when you get hit, so your casts go off on time even with a mob on you. At 29, put one more point into Call of Flame.
Magma Totem at 26 deals Fire damage to nearby enemies every 2 seconds. Pair it with Fire Nova against groups.
Mana Spring Totem at 26 restores mana to nearby party members. Make it your Water totem in groups with several casters.
Go for Whisperwind Headdress and Death Speaker Mantle in Razorfen Kraul, and Acidic Walkers and Spidertank Oilrag in Gnomeregan.

steps.title: Level 30: Call of the Ancestors
tips: At 30, put your first point into Lightning Overload. Lightning Bolt gets a 3% chance to cast a similar spell on the same target for no mana, dealing half damage.
Call of the Ancestors at 30 can drop a different totem set than Call of the Elements. Keep one set for solo play and one for groups.
Reincarnation at 30 lets you rise again on the spot with 20% health and mana after dying.

Go for Swinetusk Shank in Razorfen Kraul and Bloodmage Mantle and Embalmed Shroud in Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, and pick up Shilly Mitts from a Gnomeregan quest. Craft Skycaller's Leather Belt with Leatherworking.
Razorfen Downs (entry 25) and Uldaman (entry 30) are open, but their recommended level is above 30. Go with a geared group.
If you're entering The Forever Open, the level 30 duel tournament, set up your talents, gear and consumables with the Shaman edition of the duel tournament guide.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: Get a wand first
tips: Equip Novice's Practice Wand right away, then swap to Lesser Magic Wand at 5 and Greater Magic Wand at 13. You make all of them yourself with Enchanting.
Pull from range with Fireball, then finish with your wand. It has great base damage and a long reach, which makes it the most consistent opener.
Pick up Tailoring and Enchanting now. Crafted gear is the easiest way to stack Intellect, Spell Power and Spirit.
From level 4, conjure your own drinks with Conjure Water.

steps.title: Hunt on a mana budget
tips: Arcane Missiles arrives at 8 but costs a lot of mana. Until its second rank at 16, finishing with your wand does more damage.
From 6, read the scrolls you find while leveling with Comprehend Scroll. They unlock strong abilities and buffs.

steps.title: Talents and first crafted gear
tips: Max Wand Specialization at 10–11 to boost your wand damage, then start Arcane Focus at 12 for Arcane spell hit chance.
When enemies are hitting you, use Frost Nova (level 10) freely to take fewer hits.
Craft Novice Arcanist's Sash (10) and Heavy Woolen Gloves (12) with Tailoring. The recipe for Pearly Boots (12) is bought with Merchant's Favor, earned by turning in supply crates.

steps.title: Into the dungeons
tips: At 13, upgrade your wand to Greater Magic Wand.
The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16. Grab their quests for the rewards too.
Arcane Explosion (14) hits hard for little mana, so spam it while the tank holds a pack. Arcane Subtlety at 15–16 lowers the threat of your Arcane spells, so you can spam it more freely.
On small packs of 1–2, wand while you regain mana, then spend it on the big 4–5 mob packs.
At 15 craft Filigreed Pearly Gown (Arcane spell power) and Red Woolen Boots, plus Pearly Gloves with Merchant's Favor, then Heavy Woolen Cloak at 16.

steps.title: Arcane Blast and dungeon gear
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18.
Arcane Concentration at 17–19 gives your damage spells a chance to make your next damage spell cost no mana.
Craft Heavy Woolen Pants and Double-Stitched Woolen Shoulders (17), then Reinforced Woolen Shoulders (19) with Tailoring.
With Merchant's Favor, also make Pearly Sash (17).
Prioritize gear with Intellect, Spell Power and Spirit. It matters most in dungeons.
Take Arcane Blast at 20. Four stacks drain your mana fast, so stop at 2–3 and follow with Arcane Missiles.
Use Evocation (level 20) often between bosses. Even short channels are far better than not using it at all.
Finish Tailoring with Spidersilk Boots and Filigreed Pearly Leggings, and spend Merchant's Favor on Pearly Circlet.
For your wand, aim for Sizzle Stick ( Wailing Caverns quest reward), which has the most Spell Power.

steps.title: Finishing Arcane Concentration
tips: Finish Arcane Concentration at 21–22 for more free spells, then take Arcane Impact at 23–24 for more Arcane crit chance.
New ranks of Arcane Explosion (22) and Arcane Missiles (24) arrive here. Train them right away.
Blackfathom Deeps opens at 22 and The Stockade at 23. Dungeon quests now give only half as much bonus experience on top of normal quest values, so pick them up for the gear rewards.
Use Counterspell (24) to stop dungeon casters and healers. It generates a lot of threat, so wait until the tank has the enemy.
Scroll spells from Comprehend Scroll can no longer be cast while moving, so stand still to use them.
At 22, craft Pearly Gown with Tailoring.

steps.title: Arcane on a mana budget
tips: Arcane Meditation (25–27) keeps part of your mana regeneration going while casting, so you drink far less often.
Missile Barrage (28) gives Arcane Blast a chance to make your next Arcane Missiles free and twice as fast. When it procs, cast Arcane Missiles right away.
Finish Arcane Impact at 29.
Conjure Mana Agate (28) gives you instant mana mid boss fight. Its cooldown runs separately from Evocation.
Gnomeregan and Razorfen Downs open at 25, and Excavation Site: Wetlands at 26. You can enter Razorfen Downs from 25, but it's tuned well above that, so go with a higher level group.
Razorfen Kraul has faction quests you can only pick up from 29, so go at 29 or later to finish them in one run.
At 25, craft Pearly Leggings with Tailoring.
From 25, Enchanting makes Glimmering Staff, or Orb of Mystic Insight to pair with a one-hander.

steps.title: Presence of Mind and target gear
tips: Take Presence of Mind at 30. It makes your next spell instant, so use it for a quick opener or an extra hit in a pinch.
New ranks of Arcane Blast and Arcane Explosion arrive at 30.
Swap Frost Armor for Ice Armor at 30. It gives far more armor.
At 30 you can enter Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, Scarlet Monastery Library, Scarlet Monastery Armory, Scarlet Monastery Cathedral and Uldaman.

Target gear: Embalmed Shroud and Bloodmage Mantle from Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, Thornweaver Drape, Swinetusk Shank and the quest reward Snake Hoop from Razorfen Kraul, the Gnomeregan quest reward Shilly Mitts, and Belt of Arugal from Shadowfang Keep, Spidertank Oilrag from Gnomeregan, and Golden Slippers from Tailoring.
For your neck, take the Darkspear Islands Friendly reputation reward Darkspear Warding Pendant.
For your neck, take the Darkspear Islands Friendly reputation reward Seal of the Expedition.
For a ring, Philanthropist's Ring comes from turning in 20 Library Books. Sizzle Stick is still your best wand.
If you're entering the level 30 dueling tournament, check the duel prep guide for what to get ready.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

tips: Equip Novice's Practice Wand right away, then swap to Lesser Magic Wand at 5 and Greater Magic Wand at 13. You make all of them yourself with Enchanting.
Pull from range with Fireball, then finish with your wand. At these levels the wand does respectable damage at no mana cost.
Pick up Tailoring and Enchanting now. Crafted gear is the easiest way to stack Intellect, Spell Power and Spirit.
From level 4, conjure your own drinks with Conjure Water.

steps.title: Hunt on a mana budget
tips: You learn Fire Blast at 6. Use it to finish low-health enemies or to pull the next one.
Spend mana only on the pull and fight the rest with your wand, so you are not drinking every two mobs.
From 6, read the scrolls you find while leveling with Comprehend Scroll. They unlock strong abilities and buffs.

steps.title: Talents and first crafted gear
tips: Wake of Fire at 10–11: each kill greatly raises the crit chance of your next Fire Blast. Pull the next enemy with it and finish with your wand.
From 12, Improved Fireball shortens the cast time of Fireball.
When enemies are hitting you, use Frost Nova (level 10) freely to take fewer hits.
Craft Novice Arcanist's Sash (10) and Heavy Woolen Gloves (12) with Tailoring. The recipe for Flame Boots (12) is bought with Merchant's Favor, earned by turning in supply crates.

steps.title: Into the dungeons
tips: At 13, upgrade your wand to Greater Magic Wand.
The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16. Grab their quests for the rewards too.
Ignite from 15: Fire spell crits set the target burning for extra damage. Pulling with a Wake of Fire -boosted Fire Blast is an easy way to trigger it right away.
From 16, open on packs with Flamestrike, then spam Arcane Explosion. It works best when the tank holds the whole pack.
On small packs of 1–2, wand while you regain mana, then spend it on the big 4–5 mob packs.
At 15 craft Filigreed Flame Gown (Fire spell power) and Red Woolen Boots, plus Flame Gloves with Merchant's Favor, then Heavy Woolen Cloak at 16.

steps.title: Pyroblast and dungeon gear
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18.
When pushing through dungeons at a fast pace, you lean on your wand a fair bit to keep your mana steady. Your boss damage holds up fine.
Craft Heavy Woolen Pants and Double-Stitched Woolen Shoulders (17), then Reinforced Woolen Shoulders (19) with Tailoring.
With Merchant's Favor, also make Flame Sash (17).
Prioritize gear with Intellect, Spell Power and Spirit. With low base spell damage, gear makes up a big part of your power.
Take Pyroblast at 20. Pre-cast it before the fight, then follow with Fireball.
Use Evocation (level 20) often between bosses. Even short channels are far better than not using it at all.
Finish Tailoring with Spidersilk Boots and Filigreed Flame Leggings, and spend Merchant's Favor on Flame Circlet.
For your wand, aim for Sizzle Stick ( Wailing Caverns quest reward), which has the most Spell Power.

steps.title: Faster Fireballs
tips: Finish Improved Fireball at 21–22 to cut Fireball 's cast time further. Burning Soul at 23–24 helps you keep casting while being hit and lowers the threat of your Fire spells.
Scorch (22) has a short cast, so use it instead of Fireball when an enemy is nearly dead or you need to finish quickly.
Blackfathom Deeps opens at 22 and The Stockade at 23. Dungeon quests now give only half as much bonus experience on top of normal quest values, so pick them up for the gear rewards.
Use Counterspell (24) to stop dungeon casters and healers. It generates a lot of threat, so wait until the tank has the enemy.
Scroll spells from Comprehend Scroll can no longer be cast while moving, so stand still to use them.
At 22, craft Flame Gown with Tailoring.

steps.title: Crits speed up Pyroblast
tips: Take Heating Up at 25. Every Fireball, Fire Blast or Scorch crit shortens your next Pyroblast cast, stacking up to 3 times. Cast Pyroblast once it's fully stacked.
Master of Elements (26–28) refunds part of the mana cost when your Fire and Frost spells crit. Together with Ignite, the more you crit, the longer you can keep going.
Finish Burning Soul at 29.
Conjure Mana Agate (28) gives you instant mana mid boss fight. Its cooldown runs separately from Evocation.
Gnomeregan and Razorfen Downs open at 25, and Excavation Site: Wetlands at 26. You can enter Razorfen Downs from 25, but it's tuned well above that, so go with a higher level group.
Razorfen Kraul has faction quests you can only pick up from 29, so go at 29 or later to finish them in one run.
At 25, craft Flame Leggings and Phoenix Bindings with Tailoring.
From 25, Enchanting makes Glimmering Staff, or Orb of Mystic Insight to pair with a one-hander.

steps.title: Blast Wave and target gear
tips: Take Blast Wave at 30. It deals Fire damage to all nearby enemies and slows their movement speed by 50% for 6 sec, so when several mobs are on you, you can hit them all at once and get some distance. New ranks of Fireball, Fire Blast and Pyroblast also arrive at 30, so train them right away.
Swap Frost Armor for Ice Armor at 30. It gives far more armor.
At 30 you can enter Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, Scarlet Monastery Library, Scarlet Monastery Armory, Scarlet Monastery Cathedral and Uldaman.

Target gear: Embalmed Shroud and Bloodmage Mantle from Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, Thornweaver Drape, Swinetusk Shank and the quest reward Snake Hoop from Razorfen Kraul, the Gnomeregan quest reward Shilly Mitts, and Belt of Arugal from Shadowfang Keep, and Fiery Slippers from Tailoring.
For your neck, take the Darkspear Islands Friendly reputation reward Darkspear Warding Pendant.

steps.title: Talents and first crafted gear
tips: Put two points into Improved Frostbolt at 10–11 to cut Frostbolt 's cast time by 0.2 sec, then three points into Elemental Precision at 12–14. It raises the hit chance of Fire and Frost spells, so fewer casts miss and less mana is wasted.
When enemies are hitting you, use Frost Nova (level 10) freely to take fewer hits.

steps.title: Into the dungeons
tips: At 13, upgrade your wand to Greater Magic Wand.
The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16. Grab their quests for the rewards too.

Start Frostbite at 15. Your Chill effects such as Frostbolt get a chance to freeze the enemy in place for 5 sec, giving you free hits without taking damage. With all three points at 17, the chance is 15%.
Use Arcane Explosion (14) on 3 or more enemies, and spam it while the tank holds the pack.

steps.title: Ice Lance and dungeon gear
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18.
Craft Heavy Woolen Pants and Double-Stitched Woolen Shoulders (17), then Reinforced Woolen Shoulders (19) with Tailoring.
With Merchant's Favor, also make Silky Sash (17).
Get as much Intellect and Spell Power as you can, since it raises both how many spells you can cast and how hard they hit.
At 18–19, put two points into Ice Shards to raise the critical strike damage of your Frost spells by 40%.
Take Ice Lance at 20. It deals far more damage to targets frozen by Frost Nova and similar effects.
Use Evocation (level 20) often between bosses. Even short channels are far better than not using it at all.
Finish Tailoring with Spidersilk Boots and Filigreed Silky Leggings, and spend Merchant's Favor on Silky Circlet.

steps.title: Ice Shards and Piercing Ice
tips: Max out Ice Shards at 21–23 to raise the critical strike damage of your Frost spells by 100%, then put your first point into Piercing Ice at 24 for 2% more Frost damage.
Put up Frost Ward (22) before fighting enemies or bosses that deal Frost damage.
Blackfathom Deeps opens at 22 and The Stockade at 23. Dungeon quests now give only half as much bonus experience on top of normal quest values, so pick them up for the gear rewards.

steps.title: Shatter and Ice Block
tips: Shatter (25–27) greatly raises your critical strike chance against frozen targets. Freeze with Frost Nova, then cast Ice Lance; with Ice Shards on top, each hit lands very hard.
Cone of Cold (26) damages and slows a pack in front of you. Root the pack with Frost Nova, step back, then use it alongside Blizzard.

Take Ice Block at 28. It protects you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, so use it to survive when too many mobs are on you or your health is nearly gone. At 29, put one more point into Piercing Ice.

steps.title: Fingers of Frost and target gear
tips: Take Fingers of Frost at 30. Your Chill effects such as Frostbolt can make your next spell act as if the target were frozen, so spend that on Ice Lance.

steps.title: Suppression, Soul Harvest and the Succubus
tips: Put three points into Suppression at 17–19. It raises your hit chance by 3%, so fewer spells miss and waste mana, and you draw less threat.

tips: Put three points into Improved Drains at 21–23 to raise the health drained by Drain Life by 20%, then put a second point into Soul Harvest at 24. tips: Take Nightfall at 25–26. When Corruption or your drain spells deal damage, there is a 4% chance your next Shadow Bolt becomes instant. Use it as soon as it procs.

Banish at 28 locks down a demon or elemental for up to 20 seconds. Use it to take one enemy out of a dungeon pull.

Craft Lesser Mystic Wand and Orb of Mystic Insight with Enchanting, and Shadow Leggings and Shadow Hood with Tailoring. Staff of the Shade and Death Speaker Mantle from Razorfen Kraul and Spidertank Oilrag from Gnomeregan are good too.
Finish the Orb of Soran'ruk quest while running Blackfathom Deeps and Shadowfang Keep. Both the orb and the staff hold up through level 30.

steps.title: One target at a time, from range
tips: Pull with Wrath from range and fight one enemy at a time. Two or more split you between healing and damage and drain your mana fast.
Keep Mark of the Wild up and top yourself off with Rejuvenation between fights.

Early consumables and professions matter more to Balance than to any other leveling spec. Pick up Leatherworking and Alchemy right away and keep Minor Arcane Elixir and Minor Wizard Oil on hand. Cooking, First Aid and Fishing don't use your two profession slots, so level them too.

steps.title: Thorns and roots
tips: Keep Thorns up at all times. It locks in your spell power when cast, so apply it with your spell power gear and elixir on.
At 8, hold the enemy at range with Entangling Roots and cast Wrath. Recast roots when it breaks free.
If your mana can't keep up, melee in caster form: one Moonfire, Entangling Roots and auto attacks, with Rejuvenation between fights. It's slower but more consistent.

steps.title: Spell power weapon and Improved Wrath
tips: From level 10, caster weapons carry spell power. Swap to a spell power staff, dagger or mace from dungeon drops or quest rewards. It's the single biggest boost to your damage while leveling.
Start your talents with Improved Wrath. With all five points, Wrath becomes a 1.5-second cast and costs less mana.
Craft Moonglow Boots, Fine Leather Gloves and Embossed Leather Pants with Leatherworking, and swap to Stormrider's Leather Belt at 12. Switch your food to Smoked Sagefish.
The level 10 class quest gives Bear Form, but as Balance you keep hunting in caster form.

steps.title: First dungeons and Moonglow
tips: Prioritize dungeons while leveling, because gear upgrades change how Balance feels more than new spell ranks do. The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16.

In dungeons you are the backup healer. Don't spend all your mana on damage; keep enough for Rejuvenation and Regrowth. Use Entangling Roots to hold a runner or a caster out of the pack so the tank and healer have less to manage.
From 15, take Moonglow. It lowers the mana cost of your damage spells and is the most important leveling talent, since mana, not damage, is what holds Balance back.
Craft Stormrider's Leather Armor and Stormrider's Leather Gloves at 15 with Leatherworking, and add spell power to chest, legs, hands or feet with Mystic Medium Armor Kit.

steps.title: Wailing Caverns and Starfire
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18. Pick up every dungeon quest before you go in to collect the staff and robe rewards in one run.
From 18, take Nature's Majesty for more critical strike chance.
Keep upgrading to higher spell power staves such as Coldspire Staff (level 19), Emberstone Staff or Crescent Staff.
You learn Starfire at 20. Spell power scales Wrath at 57.1% and Starfire at 100%, so every spell power upgrade pays off more.
Your level 20 point goes into Improved Entangling Roots. Entangling Roots holds through more damage, so you can keep mobs pinned at range and kill them safely.
Craft Totemic Leather Hood and Totemic Leather Pants with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Nature's Splendor and Blackfathom Deeps
tips: Nature's Splendor at 21 extends Moonfire, Rejuvenation and Regrowth. Improved Moonfire at 22 and 23 adds damage and crit chance to Moonfire.
Nature's Reach at 24 extends the range of your Balance attacks by 20%. Pulling from farther away buys one more cast before the mob reaches you.
Wrath and Moonfire get new ranks at 22, and you learn Remove Curse at 24. Use it to clear curses from your group in dungeons.
Rod of the Sleepwalker from Blackfathom Deeps is the staff to chase here. Craft Stormrider's Leather Tunic and Stormrider's Leather Pants with Leatherworking.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience. Grab every quest and run each dungeon once, then go back only for gear.

steps.title: Insect Swarm and Vengeance
tips: Take Insect Swarm at 25. It lowers the target's chance to hit by 2% and deals damage over time. Keep it up alongside Moonfire and finish with Wrath.
Put 26 to 29 into Vengeance for bigger Arcane and Nature crits. It pairs well with the crit chance from Nature's Majesty, which you took at 18.
Brew Lesser Arcane Elixir and Lesser Mageblood Elixir at 25 with Alchemy. Starfire gets a new rank at 26.

Also pick up Hammerbone from the Wailing Caverns quest, plus Snake Eye Kaleidoscope and Serpent's Shoulders.
