At 12, craft Defender's Leather Belt with Leatherworking. Switch your food to Smoked Sagefish.

steps.title: Tanking your first dungeons
tips: The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16. Your first clear with all the related quests in hand is the most rewarding. Dungeon mobs give reduced experience, so repeat runs are inefficient.
To tank, pull with Wrath from range, then shift into Bear Form. Keep Demoralizing Roar up and hold threat with Maul on one target and Swipe (level 16) on several.
From 15, take Feral Swiftness. It raises your dodge chance, and the faster Cat Form movement is very strong for leveling past 20.
Aim for Segmented Spider Leg in Ruins of Lordaeron, and craft Defender's Leather Gloves at 15 with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Fang set and Feral Charge
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18. The Fang set has good stats, and wearing all of it turns Cat Form into a serpent.
From 17, take Feral Instinct to increase Swipe damage, making it easier to hold several enemies.
Bear damage scales with your weapon's DPS. Upgrade to Smite's Mighty Hammer from The Deadmines, or the Wailing Caverns quest rewards Hammerbone and Crescent Staff.
The level 20 class quest gives Cat Form.
Your level 20 point goes into Feral Charge. It charges an enemy, pins it and interrupts its spell, which is handy for grabbing casters at range.
Craft Defender's Leather Hood and Defender's Leather Pants with Leatherworking, and Bronze Warhammer with Blacksmithing.

steps.title: Thick Hide and Blackfathom Deeps
tips: From 21, Thick Hide raises your armor in forms. From 24, Savage Fury adds damage to Maul and Swipe.
Bear Form gains 75% more Rage from critical strikes, and Swipe adds 3% of your attack power to its damage. Swipe gets a new rank at 24, which makes holding several mobs much easier.
Tank Blackfathom Deeps and The Stockade. Craft Defender's Leather Tunic with Leatherworking.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience. Grab every quest and run each dungeon once, then go back only for gear.

steps.title: Primal Bite and Gnomeregan
tips: Take Primal Bite at 26. It generates a very large amount of threat. On a single target, use it on cooldown and spend leftover Rage on Maul.
From 27, Sharpened Claws raises your crit chance, then Blood Frenzy from 29. The more you crit, the more Rage your bear has to work with.
Challenging Roar at 28 makes every nearby enemy attack you for 6 seconds. Save it for when a pack turns on your healer.

Manual Crowd Pummeler from Gnomeregan is the best weapon you can get by 30. Until then, craft Golden Iron Destroyer with Blacksmithing. Razorfen Downs opens at 25 but is tuned for 34, and the new Excavation Site: Wetlands is for levels 26 to 31.

Craft Defender's Leather Kilt and Defender's Leather Helm at 25 and Barbaric Bracers at 27 with Leatherworking. In Razorfen Kraul, aim for the two-handed Slaghammer, the Wolfclaw Gloves gloves and Mantle of Thieves, a good shoulder piece.

steps.title: Scarlet Monastery and target gear
tips: At 30, finish Blood Frenzy and Bash gets a new rank. You also learn Travel Form for 40% movement speed outdoors.

Ebon Vise, Ghostshard Talisman and Ironspine's Eye from Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, plus Warden's Leather Belt and Barbaric Shoulders from Leatherworking, are the core of your target gear. Uldaman opens at 30.
If you're entering the level 30 duel tournament, check the duel tournament prep guide too.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

steps.title: One target at a time with Wrath
tips: Pull with Wrath from range and fight one enemy at a time.
Keep Mark of the Wild up and top yourself off with Rejuvenation between fights.
Pick up Skinning and Leatherworking right away. Cooking, First Aid and Fishing don't use your two profession slots, so level them too.

steps.title: Thorns and roots
tips: Keep Thorns up at all times. It scales with spell power, so cast it with your spell power gear on.
At 8, hold the enemy at range with Entangling Roots and cast Wrath. Recast roots when it breaks free.

steps.title: Improved Wrath and Regrowth
tips: Put five points into Improved Wrath in the Balance tree at 10–14. Wrath casts 0.5 sec faster and costs 50% less mana, so you kill more mobs between drinks.
From level 10, caster weapons carry spell power. Swap to a spell power staff, dagger or mace from dungeon drops or quest rewards. You learn Regrowth at 12.
At 12, craft Wisdom's Leather Belt with Leatherworking. Switch your food to Smoked Sagefish.

steps.title: Healing your first dungeons
tips: The Hall of Thanes and Ragefire Chasm open at 13, Ruins of Lordaeron at 15 and The Deadmines at 16.

In dungeons, let the Rejuvenation and Regrowth HoT ticks heal the damage. Save direct heals for when someone is low enough to take the full heal; the long gaps let the five-second rule lapse so your mana comes back fast.
Keep Thorns on the active tank.
Put five points into Nature's Focus at 15–19. Taking damage while casting Wrath or a heal has a 70% chance not to interrupt you, so you can finish a mob or heal yourself even when it's on you.
Craft Wisdom's Leather Armor, Wisdom's Leather Gloves and Black Whelp Cloak at 15 with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Wailing Caverns and Omen of Clarity
tips: Wailing Caverns opens at 17 and Shadowfang Keep at 18. Healing chest pieces like Robe of the Moccasin, Corsair's Overshirt and Bloody Apron drop here.
Skum's Bucket from Wailing Caverns restores mana when used while seated.
With enough healing power on your gear, even rank 2 Healing Touch becomes strong enough to carry your healing.
You learn Omen of Clarity at 20. Run in and melee between casts to trigger it more often; the free cast doesn't break the five-second rule, so your mana keeps regenerating.
From 20, take Naturalist. With all five points by 24, Healing Touch casts 0.5 sec faster and all your damage goes up by 5%, helping both healing and solo questing.
Rebirth at 20 is a resurrection you can use in combat, unlike Revive. It has a 30 minute cooldown, so save it for when it really matters.
Craft Wisdom's Leather Hood and Wisdom's Leather Pants with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Naturalist and Blackfathom Deeps
tips: Finish Naturalist at 21–24 to bring the bonus to all your damage up to 5%.
Rejuvenation gets a new rank at 22 and Regrowth at 24, and you learn Remove Curse at 24. Use it to clear curses from your group in dungeons.
The Blackfathom Deeps quest rewards Prelacy Cape and Nimbus Boots are healing pieces you can wear until 30. The Stockade also fits this range. Craft Wisdom's Leather Tunic with Leatherworking.
Dungeon quests now give half as much bonus experience. Grab every quest and run each dungeon once, then go back only for gear.

steps.title: Reflection and Gift of Nature
tips: Put three points into Reflection at 25–27. Your mana keeps regenerating at 50% of the normal rate while casting, so you run dry less whether you're questing or healing a dungeon. Then put two points into Gift of Nature at 28–29 for 4% more healing.
Abolish Poison at 26 keeps removing poisons, one every 2 seconds for 8 seconds.

Go for Death Speaker Scepter, Death Speaker Robes and Wind Spirit Staff in Razorfen Kraul, and Thermaplugg Medal of Honor and Electrocutioner Lagnut in Gnomeregan. Razorfen Downs opens at 25 but is tuned for 34, and the new Excavation Site: Wetlands is for levels 26 to 31.
Craft Wisdom's Leather Leggings at 25 with Leatherworking.

steps.title: Swiftmend and Tranquility
tips: Take Swiftmend at 30. It instantly delivers a big heal on a target that has Rejuvenation or Regrowth, so use it when the tank's health or your own suddenly drops.

Tranquility at 30 heals every party member within 20 yards over 10 seconds. It's channeled and has a 5 minute cooldown, so save it for when the whole group takes heavy damage. You also learn Travel Form.
Your target gear centers on Embalmed Shroud from Scarlet Monastery Graveyard, Death Speaker Scepter from Razorfen Kraul and Mender's Leather Belt from Leatherworking. Uldaman opens at 30.
If you're entering the level 30 duel tournament, check the duel tournament prep guide too.
Once you reach 30, work toward the BiS gear below and reset your talents into the level 30 build shown just above the gear list.

zones.name: Zephras Isle
zones.location: A floating isle in the elemental skies, anchored in the elemental plane by the wind spirits
zones.summary: The Skyborne (shen'dorei, the 'hidden people') descend from those who left Eldre'Thalas after the War of the Ancients. Their elemental benefactors have vanished and the pylons holding the isle together are failing, so parts of Zephras are falling into ruin. Classic Warcraft style meets architecture inspired by Skywall.

zones.name: Riverglades
zones.location: Eastern Kingdoms: a previously inaccessible part of the Classic world bordering the Burning Steppes, Redridge Mountains, Swamp of Sorrows and Badlands
zones.summary: A rugged frontier of rivers, grasslands, trade routes, struggling communities and old grudges. It is roughly the size of Stranglethorn Vale and holds more than 150 quests (per the What's Next recap; nearly 200 per the world design panel recap). Blizzard calls it one of the first major examples of 'new, but familiar' content.

zones.name: Mount Hyjal
zones.location: The World Tree's mountain in northern Kalimdor, reached through Darkwhisper Gorge
zones.summary: Explore the aftermath of the Battle for Mount Hyjal and Archimonde's defeat, meet emerging factions, form alliances and help shape the future of a recovering land, with a journey through Darkwhisper Gorge.

zones.name: Shen'dralas
zones.location: Between Mulgore and Desolace in Kalimdor, entered south of Desolace through the Valley of Bones
zones.summary: A long-hidden mystery between Mulgore and Desolace opens new adventures tied to the Shen'dralar, Eldre'Thalas, Dire Maul and the local centaur tribes.

zones.name: The Hall of Thanes
zones.summary: Royal dwarven burial chambers deep below Ironforge.

zones.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
zones.location: Tirisfal Glades · the old capital above the Undercity
zones.summary: Help the Forsaken reclaim the ruins of their former kingdom.

zones.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
zones.summary: A Titan dig site above Whelgar's Excavation, wrapped in strange mist and flashes of light.

zones.name: City of Dalaran
zones.location: Alterac Mountains · the mage city on Lordamere Lake
zones.summary: Strange magical happenings in the turbulent city of Dalaran.

zones.name: The Drowned City
zones.summary: Naga and pirates in a sunken city.

zones.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
zones.summary: A sprawling outdoor ogre stronghold. BlizzCon materials listed 40–55; Blizzard corrected it to 40–45.

zones.name: Alcaz Prison
zones.summary: The Defias and the naga clash in the prison on Alcaz Island.

zones.name: Blackmaw Hold
zones.summary: A furbolg city behind Azshara's mysterious gate. Corruption threatens its people, and its tunnels lead toward the Barrow Deeps raid.

zones.name: Shaper's Terrace
zones.summary: A Titan facility in the hills of Un'Goro Crater, full of ancient machinery, power crystals and uncontrolled wildlife.

zones.name: The Barrow Deeps
zones.location: A sacred night elf prison, with one of its three entrances reportedly in Mount Hyjal
zones.summary: Planned as a maximum-level 10-player challenge with new tier sets and a legendary reward.

zones.name: Hyjal Summit
zones.summary: 20-player raid encounters at one of Warcraft's most important locations, with new tier sets and a legendary reward.

zones.name: Onyxia's Lair
zones.summary: The classic 40-player raid, unlocking on the same day as the two new raids on the roadmap.

zones.name: Darkspear Islands
zones.summary: A 15 vs 15 battleground combining strategic control points with Arathi Basin-style flag captures and defense.

zones.name: Stormwind Harbor ↔ Auberdine
zones.summary: An early path between the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor, from the new Stormwind Harbor.

zones.name: Menethil · Southshore · Auberdine
zones.summary: A ship calling at Menethil Harbor, Southshore and Auberdine in turn. Beta players report it replaces the old direct Menethil ↔ Auberdine boat.

zones.name: Tanaris ↔ Powderfuse Port
zones.summary: Starts with the Steamwheedle Cartel in Tanaris and sails beyond known shores to Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

zones.name: Valanaar ↔ Dalaran
zones.summary: A skyship between Valanaar's eastern dock on Zephras Isle and north of Dalaran in the Alterac Mountains, the Alliance Skyborne's way into Azeroth.

zones.name: Valanaar ↔ Thunder Bluff
zones.summary: A skyship between Valanaar's western dock on Zephras Isle and just north of Thunder Bluff in Mulgore, the Horde Skyborne's way into Azeroth.

zones.name: Valley of Trials, Shadowglen and other starting areas
zones.summary: New NPCs, quests and recipes.

zones.name: Wetlands
zones.summary: New quests building on existing characters and threads, plus the new Excavation Site dungeon.

zones.name: Desolace
zones.summary: More centaur faction quests and rewards, and Shen'dralas opens through the Valley of Bones to the south.

zones.name: Bandarion Keep (Whispering Wood, Tirisfal Glades)
zones.summary: The key location for the new Forsaken Paladin experience.
